name: Guiding Bolt
summary: Hurls a bolt of light that deals Radiant damage and gives the next attack against the target Advantage.

stats.effect: You hurl a bolt of light toward a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, it takes 4d6 Radiant damage, and the next attack roll made against it before the end of your next turn has Advantage.
stats.higherLevels: The damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 1.
